description: Angular component for displaying and selecting material icons with search and responsive layout features.

classes.name: MaterialIconsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing and displaying material icons with search, selection, and responsive layout.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up observables for icon rows, and determines layout based on screen size.

methods.name: clearIcon
methods.description: Emits null to clear the selected icon.

methods.name: calculatePanelSize
methods.description: Calculates and sets the size of the icons panel based on row size and number of icon rows.

methods.name: checkSize
methods.description: Checks and updates the size of the icons panel and popover position.
